trigger: In one release a schema addition (panel_adjudication, I41) landed ELEVEN MINUTES after a script that hand-mirrors those schemas. Its self-test went red (69/71) and the script began advising that the new field be folded into audit_notes - destroying an object the same release's I41-1 requires. Two of the release's own new pieces destroyed each other.
lesson: When one artifact hand-mirrors another's schema, a sibling unit editing that schema silently rots the mirror, and per-unit verification structurally cannot catch it because each unit passes on its own scope.
how_to_apply: When one artifact hand-mirrors another's schema, a sibling unit editing that schema silently rots the mirror, and per-unit verification structurally cannot catch it because each unit passes on its own scope. At Phase-4 critique, identify every mirror relationship and assign ONE unit to own both sides, or add a cross-unit acceptance criterion. Make mirror checks BIDIRECTIONAL - a forward-only check can never notice a newly ADDED pointer. Add the re-run obligation to the repo's editing guidance, since nothing invokes a self-test automatically.
evidence: dag run 2026-07-29_090706_cross-repo-lessons-intake: 9 units, 6 retry iterations, 33 independent lens-verdicts across panels of 3 at depth tier full. Shipped as PR #34 (commits 0fd8dbe, f7c3d92).
